name: Power Source Selection
description: The choice between battery power and wall tap is one of the most significant operational decisions for any dropped implant. Battery-powered devices are self-contained but have finite operational lifetime. Wall-tapped devices operate indefinitely but require access to a power outlet and limit placement options. PoE-powered implants placed at network ports are a particularly elegant solution when available, as network connectivity and power arrive on the same cable.

blue.det: Wall tap devices may cause electrical anomalies; USB power bank limits operational time; discovery during physical sweep.
blue.cm: Regular physical inspection of power outlets and USB charging points; monitor for unauthorized wall tap devices; RF monitoring to detect battery-powered implants nearing end of life.
